purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Kiharu Form 34B final TOTAL row and preserve an internal source denominator conflict without promotion.

sample.review_context_note: This constituency's official upload is a 3-page condensed scan (each PDF page holds multiple original tally sheets; the printed page header on the final page reads 'CON 106 09/18'), so the ordinary green-shading TOTAL-row auto-locator does not apply. The TOTAL row was located manually on the final page (page 3 of 3), immediately after the 'MURANGA PRISON' and 'MURANGA WOMEN' special-facility polling station rows, and re-read at 300 DPI.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session (via the governed form_id = constituency_code + 277628 locator, after resetting the portal session from its default by-election context to the 2022 general election via index.php?r=common/set-election&id=5), its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image at 100 DPI (full-page layout) and again at 300 DPI (close crop) with identical results both times. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-106-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), sourced from the pre-election official IEBC First Schedule registered-voters gazette, published 2022-06-21

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 80,743 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (119,465) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (119,389). The 76-voter gap exactly equals the sum of two special-facility polling stations printed on the same page immediately above the TOTAL row: MURANGA PRISON (71 registered voters, code 049292145104801) and MURANGA WOMEN (5 registered voters, code 049292145104901), which sit in a national-facility ward code outside the ordinary Kiharu constituency ward series that the governed First Schedule denominator sums from. This is the same genuine printed-total-vs-ward-derived-denominator gap already documented for other constituencies' special-facility polling stations. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled.
